about: Painted vehicles (2x density: 2 image px per layout unit), side view facing right. `camper` is the composed camper with the motorcycle on its crosswise rear carrier: draw it with its ground line on the road; `van` is the camper alone (its van offset inside `camper` is camper.van). ground = the y of the wheels' contact line in image px.
